sources: E09 shared1140 state; E10 frozen reference and24 single-batch final1520 states. Original CTD child trajectories unchanged.

conditions.train400: Training cameras matching all20 test times,400px

targets: Frozen teacher float render and canonical white-composited real GT.800px GT from upstream Scene loader;400px by torch area downsample. Test800 GT checked against baseline PNG and uses saved PNG floats for E10 parity.
mix: 0.8L1+0.2(1-SSIM). Floating RGB[0,1];8bit prediction round(pred*255)/255 only for u8 metrics. Mean PSNR computed per view then averaged, not PSNR of mean MSE.
identity: MSE(student,GT)=MSE(student,teacher)+MSE(teacher,GT)+2mean((student-teacher)*(teacher-GT)). Gain uses reference minus proposal at same phase; teacher-GT term cancels.
primary: Correlate four phase0 fit400 scores (teacher/GT x mixed/MSE) with phase380 same-fit400 GT MSE gain, paired train/test400/800 GT MSE gains and E10 official GT PSNR gain. Every24 candidate retained; no best-policy selection.
secondary: Phase380 gain-rank transfer train400 vs test400,train800 vs test800,test400 vs test800;floatMSE vs quantizedMSE vs mean per-view PSNR;teacher-MSE gain vs GT-MSE gain and cross-term contribution.
guards: All input/model hashes unchanged, shared1140 digest, same geometry recipes asE10,fit400 teacher mixed loss parity withE10 at phases0/380,test800 quantizedGT PSNR/MSE parity withE10 per-view records. No new training or optimizer steps.
limitations: Exploratory24 related batches from CTD top512, one scene/order
Paired train/test views share times but differ cameras; paired times may be outside reduction fit
Training GT and teacher scores are diagnostics, not implemented/retrained supervision policies
Test-view scores are explanatory only, unavailable for future candidate selection
Teacher bias and metric/camera/resolution effects measured here do not establish one exclusive cause or statistical significance
